subject: [PATCH 2/5] mm/huge_memory: dequeue the deferred split after the split freeze

2026-08-27.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of __folio_freeze_and_split_unmapped in the Linux kernel's huge_memory module. It removes a workaround that was previously necessary due to issues with deferred_split_isolate, and instead unqueues the folio from the deferred split list after it has been frozen and its memory control group is still set. This change ensures that the PG_partially_mapped flag is cleared after splitting, which is necessary for accurate statistics tracking.
